## Valuation Insights

**Profitability: 5/5**

Apple’s net sales grew 15.1% year over year to $478.8 billion for fiscal 2026, outpacing prior-year growth.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=478834000000;416161000000|result=0.1506|definition=Revenue growth] -->
Operating income rose to $158.1 billion, driven by a 1.7-point margin expansion to 33.0%.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=158063000000;478834000000|result=0.3301|definition=Operating margin] -->

**Cash Conversion: 5/5**

Cash from operations reached $145.1 billion, a 30.2% increase year over year, while capital expenditures fell to $9.0 billion.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities|period=2025-09-28:2026-09-26|value=145097000000] -->
Free cash flow, defined as operating cash flow minus property and equipment additions, was $136.1 billion.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=145097000000;9041000000|result=136056000000|definition=Free cash flow] -->

**Financial Strength: 4/5**

Return on average equity was 142.3%, calculated using fiscal 2026 net income of $132.2 billion and average stockholders' equity of $92.9 billion.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=132175000000;92913000000|result=1.4226|definition=Return on average equity] -->
Total debt-to-equity was 0.70x, reflecting a modest leverage position.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=78114000000;112093000000|result=0.6969|definition=Debt to equity] -->

**Valuation: 3/5**

At a user-provided price of $354.02, Apple trades at 39.4x trailing diluted EPS of $8.98.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=354.02;8.98|result=39.42|definition=P/E] -->

Apple’s fiscal 2026 fourth quarter delivered operating cash flow of $28 billion, which the company used to return $28 billion to shareholders.
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->

Insight: Apple generated $136.1 billion in free cash flow in fiscal 2026, a 39.1% year-over-year increase, supporting its ability to return $102.1 billion through dividends and buybacks without increasing leverage. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->
